mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY ( snapshotDate, snapshotAt, constructionCount, headquartersDeviceCount, franchiseDeviceCount, spareDeviceCount ) SELECT CURDATE(), NOW(), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONSTRUCTION CON INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DEVICE DEV INNER JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION CON ON CON.id = DEV.constructionIdx INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE DEV.conduct = 0 AND DEV.isDel = 0 AND CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DEVICE DEV INNER JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION CON ON CON.id = DEV.constructionIdx INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE DEV.conduct = 2 AND DEV.isDel = 0 AND CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SPARE_DEVICE SD INNER JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION CON ON CON.id = SD.constructionIdx INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE SD.type = 0 AND SD.status = 0 AND CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 AND GP.isDel = 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshotAt = VALUES(snapshotAt), constructionCount = VALUES(constructionCount), headquartersDeviceCount = VALUES(headquartersDeviceCount), franchiseDeviceCount = VALUES(franchiseDeviceCount), spareDeviceCount = VALUES(spareDeviceCount)
mapper.select: SELECT headquartersDeviceCount + franchiseDeviceCount FROM TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY WHERE snapshotDate = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T.snapshotDate, '%m.%d') AS axisLabel, DATE_FORMAT(T.snapshotDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS tooltipLabel, T.headquartersDeviceCount + T.franchiseDeviceCount AS deviceCount FROM ( SELECT snapshotDate, headquartersDeviceCount, franchiseDeviceCount FROM TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY ORDER BY snapshotDate DESC LIMIT 30 ) T ORDER BY T.snapshotDate ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T.snapshotDate, '%m월') AS axisLabel, DATE_FORMAT(T.snapshotDate, '%Y년 %m월') AS tooltipLabel, T.headquartersDeviceCount + T.franchiseDeviceCount AS deviceCount FROM ( SELECT S.snapshotDate, S.headquartersDeviceCount, S.franchiseDeviceCount FROM TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY S INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(snapshotDate) AS lastSnapshotDate FROM TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(snapshotDate, '%Y-%m') ) L ON S.snapshotDate = L.lastSnapshotDate ORDER BY S.snapshotDate DESC LIMIT 12 ) T ORDER BY T.snapshotDate ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T.snapshotDate, '%Y년') AS axisLabel, DATE_FORMAT(T.snapshotDate, '%Y년') AS tooltipLabel, T.headquartersDeviceCount + T.franchiseDeviceCount AS deviceCount FROM ( SELECT S.snapshotDate, S.headquartersDeviceCount, S.franchiseDeviceCount FROM TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY S INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(snapshotDate) AS lastSnapshotDate FROM TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY GROUP BY YEAR(snapshotDate) ) L ON S.snapshotDate = L.lastSnapshotDate ORDER BY S.snapshotDate DESC LIMIT 10 ) T ORDER BY T.snapshotDate ASC
